{{Top|leg}}
The '''Basic Dictionary''' was a dictionary of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] words. [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] joked with [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Hobbie Klivian]] as he defined a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the dictionary as "a guy who flies an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] without getting blown up".

{{Book-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
"Basic Dictionary" may have been a generalized colloquialism rather than an actual book, or a shorthand reference to the [[Riccix New Galactic Dictionary]].
